verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada publishes exact dollar amounts on its own services-fees-and-processing-times and federal-incorporation pages: $200 for online incorporation, $100 extra for 4-hour express, $250 by email or mail, $200 for amendments and $250 for exemptions, each paired with its channel and processing time. No contact form is needed to learn the fee. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the published fees, and fee amounts for other transactions such as the annual return.
